summary: Iteration 8 tested new Home Company FAQ feature end-to-end: settings merge (home_faq with 8 defaults), company-kind AI generation, PUT /admin/settings persistence for home_faq, Home page FAQ accordion + FAQPage JSON-LD, Organization graph including ProfessionalService, plus regressions (projeler/blog detail FAQ, robots/sitemap/llms).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1790 lines; consider splitting into routers/modules for maintainability.
PUT /admin/settings does shallow whitelist merge; nested 'pages' updates require full object replacement (potential foot-gun for partial edits from admin UI).
DEFAULT_SETTINGS home_faq embedded in server.py — consider moving to a JSON/seed file for easier editing without redeploy.
seed_data_creation: None. Test used PUT then restored original home_faq.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: /api/settings merges DEFAULT_SETTINGS so home_faq (8 items) always appears; PUT /admin/settings whitelist includes home_faq. POST /api/admin/generate-faq supports kind='company' with gpt-5.4-mini and returns Turkish Q&A referencing Dijital Roket. Frontend Home page renders data-testid=home-faq with 8 items, jsonld-home-faq (FAQPage) and jsonld-organization (Organization+WebSite+ProfessionalService). Admin Site Ayarları tab shows 'Şirket SSS' FaqEditor pre-populated from home_faq with faq-add-btn and ai-generate-faq-btn. All prior SEO endpoints (robots.txt, /sitemap.xml, /api/sitemap.xml, /llms.txt, /api/llms-full.txt) and project/blog FAQ still work.
